cena: Mr. Tanner chega ao consultório sem saber nenhum termo técnico. Ele descreve o que sente com as palavras que tem — e é justamente assim que o paciente real fala.
gramatica: this / that / these / those, adjetivos de estado e o verbo feel + adjetivo.

imagem.alt: Uma médica de jaleco branco examina o braço inchado de um paciente sentado na maca, que aponta para uma mancha avermelhada na pele.
imagem.prompt: Warm, friendly 2D vector illustration, flat modern style with soft shading. Inside a calm medical examination room. A woman doctor in a white coat over teal scrubs leans in attentively, gently holding the forearm of a middle-aged man sitting on an examination couch. The man points with his other hand to a reddish patch on his upper arm, his expression tired but calm. A stethoscope hangs around the doctor's neck. In the background: a blood pressure cuff on the wall and a small sink. Limited palette of teal, cyan, warm sand and deep navy. Clean shapes, soft shadows.
